title: Identifying the Zscaler Cloud Connector Version

blocks.text: Zscaler provides automation templates for Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). When you deploy Zscaler Cloud Connector, these templates always detect the latest virtual machine (VM) version. Therefore, as long as the latest automation templates are deployed, there is no action required when deploying new VMs. You can locate your current Cloud Connector VM version via AWS, Azure, and GCP.

blocks.heading: Cloud Connector Version Location in AWS

blocks.text: To find the current Cloud Connector version in AWS:

blocks.item: In the AWS Marketplace, on the Configure this software page, locate all current and historical marketplace OS/VM versions and corresponding Amazon Machine Images (AMIs) per region to reference after locating your current Cloud Connector version.

blocks.item: Sign in to the AWS Management Console.
In the Search bar, enter EC2. Then, under Services, select EC2.
On the EC2 Dashboard page, under Resources, select Instances. Alternatively, you can select Instances from the left-side navigation.

blocks.text: Selecting Instances (running) only shows currently deployed Cloud Connectors. Select Instances (running) only if you are searching for the version of a currently deployed Cloud Connector.

blocks.item: On the Instances page, select the Instance ID of your Cloud Connector.
On the Instance summary page, select Details.
On the Details tab, under Instance details, your Cloud Connector version information is displayed in AMI ID and AMI name.

blocks.text: A change in network interfaces occurred between releases. In version ZS6.1.24.6, device index 0 is the management interface and device index 1 is the service interface. In version ZS6.1.26.0, device index 0 is the service interface and device index 1 is the management interface.

blocks.heading: Cloud Connector Version Location in Azure

blocks.text: To find the current Cloud Connector version in Azure:

blocks.item: Sign in to the Azure portal.
In the upper-right corner of the portal, click the Cloud Shell icon.
From the drop-down menu in the Cloud Shell window, select PowerShell.
Run the following command:
Note the current Cloud Connector version.

Additionally, on the az vm list -g "resource group name" | grep -A 9 imageReference line, ensure the exactVersion for the currently deployed Cloud Connector appliance matches the previous latest version.

blocks.heading: Cloud Connector Version Location in GCP

blocks.text: To find the current Cloud Connector version in GCP:

blocks.item: Sign in to the Google Admin console.
In the Search (/) for resources, docs, products, and more field, enter VM instances.
See image.
Click VM instances.
The VM instances page appears.
On the VM instances page, in the VM instances table, click the name of your Cloud Connector.
See image.
On the Details tab, under Basic information, your Cloud Connector version information is displayed in the Boot disk source image field.
See image.
